snippet.title: Gameplay Trailer | Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
snippet.description:
Owlcat Games, alongside the launch of the Alpha, presents the new Gameplay Trailer for the upcoming Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy. Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grimdark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy.

Join the Inquisition:
Wishlist Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710600/Warhammer_40000_Dark_Heresy/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=project&utm_content=GameplayTrailer
Pre-order Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy on our website:
https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=project&utm_content=GameplayTrailer&utm_term=GameplayTrailer
